name: Camping 101: Enchanting
label: Quest
description: You can craft an Enchanted Lute, but townsfolk dislike camps in town centers. A campfire is needed to set up camp in the wilderness.
intro: You can craft an Enchanted Lute, but townsfolk dislike camps in town centers. A campfire is needed to set up camp in the wilderness.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folks don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to try it out.

No camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those as the basis of your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Check in with someone who can train you in cooking if you haven't already learned the basics.
